title: Strange Nature: The Octopus
prompt: A visualized podcast: the user supplies one episode's audio plus its transcript; the system builds an illustrated short with a consistent host figure and key-point visuals, keeps the ORIGINAL audio untouched (no re-dub), and burns English subtitles. Episode: 'Strange Nature — The Octopus' (three hearts, copper-based blue blood, arm-distributed neurons, colorblind camouflage). Key points are burned as bold on-screen cards (top) while the spoken line runs as a caption (bottom); the illustrated pages themselves stay wordless. (The 'user recording' is a synthesized 59s host read standing in for a real one — archived below, so the exact same input reproduces the experiment.)
